description: Removes one file the workspace uploaded for its reports, by the id list_report_files gives (rup_...): the file and its stored bytes go for good. Only the person who uploaded it, or an owner or admin of the workspace, may remove it. While a report of the workspace still shows the file, nothing is removed and the answer is in-use with the ids of those reports: take the file out of them, or delete them, first.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.

name: remove_report_file
title: Remove a file uploaded for reports
